messages:
olivia: Alert: unexpected cross-customer GPU surge in US-west pool overnight. Unattributed cost ~9,420 USD showing as 'unallocated'. Need quick decision whether to charge to customers or absorb.

chargeback-bot: export: https://redwood.internal/costs/uswest/3312345678-surge.csv (summary rows: 289). Top candidates from request metadata: customer-A (approx 5,200), customer-B (3,100), internal-playground (1,120).

peter: I ran a fast heuristic using request tags and session tokens: customer-A 5,200 (0.86), customer-B 3,100 (0.80), playground 1,120 (0.52). Playground confidence low.

sasha: product/legal note: we can't retro-charge customer without confirmed request id or contract clause. For customer-A/B we have request ids in logs, ok to allocate if finance approves. Internal playground should probably remain unallocated until we confirm.

leo (finance): rule: require customer ops signoff for any rebill > $2k to external customers. For internal projects we need PM signoff if > $1k. We also need ledger strings and a JIRA for audit.

olivia: I messaged customer ops for A and B. Customer ops for A confirmed the request id matches and approved charge to their account. Customer B ops requested a short audit; asked for the exact instance IDs before approval.

peter: here's a compact preview to rebill (preview):
customer-A,5200,LDG-CUST,CC-CUST-A,"request-id=REQ-9921,op-approval"
customer-B,3100,LDG-CUST,CC-CUST-B,"pending-op-approval: need instance ids"
internal-playground,1120,LDG-CORE,CC-PLAYGROUND,"low-confidence heuristic, hold"

olivia: created JIRA FIN-2026-502 "US-west cross-customer surge - 3312345678" and attached export. Assigning to @peter to complete allocation once approvals collected.

chargeback-bot: when rebill executed will create JE and attach to JIRA. Waiting on customer-B ops confirmation and playground PM signoff.

leo (finance): proposed partial rebill: go ahead with customer-A ($5,200) now, hold customer-B and playground until confirmations. JE narrative: "Partial allocation for verified customer request IDs; remaining lines held pending audit."

peter: running partial rebill for customer-A now. JE created JE-2026-USW-3312345678-PA: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-USW-3312345678-PA.csv. Attached to FIN-2026-502.

olivia: noted. Follow-ups: (1) ops to provide instance id list for customer-B, (2) PM to confirm playground ownership or let amount stay unallocated. Eng to add alert rule: if unallocated > $2k for more than 1 hour, escalate to finance and eng-oncall.

ops-bot: created incident ENG-4542 to gather instance IDs for window 2026-03-24T01:00-02:00.

peter: leaving thread to track approvals. Partial JE done and linked.
notes: Partial rebill executed for customer-A; customer-B and internal playground held pending approvals; JIRA and JE created; follow-up actions assigned
